summary: Static trace of solve.sh + fix.patch applied to the shipped package finds the patched report following every HC-4 rule (2.2-2.6, 3.1-3.3, 4.1, 1.2 rounding, 5.1-5.3, 6.1) and keeping today's step exactly where the manual is silent (above-ceiling counted-at level, below-three-quarters shift dose); patch hunks match the shipped files and the driver is untouched. No concrete incorrect behavior found.
checks_performed: Reconciled all 24 manifest entries with files read in full (no truncation).

Verified each fix.patch hunk's context and line ranges against the shipped levels.py, runs.py, shift.py, twa.py, flags.py and groups.py; solve.sh applies it with patch -p1 from / and the Dockerfile installs patch.
Confirmed tools/noisedose_run.py is not touched by the patch (instruction.md:1 byte-for-byte driver requirement).

Traced patched runs.measure: readings are runs >= 40.0 dBA (manual 2.2), sampled time sums all readings including sub-threshold ones (2.4), 0.0 runs excluded, counted readings >= 80.0 (2.3) contribute minutes / 480/2^((L-85)/3) (3.1, 3.2) at own level <= 115.0, at 115.0 above it (shipped min(level, CEILING_DBA) kept where 2.3 is silent).

Traced patched shift.shift_dose: sampled >= shift returns measured (3.3); 4*sampled >= 3*shift (integer-exact 2.5) projects by shift/sampled; otherwise the original step (0 for nothing sampled, scale to 480 when under 480, else measured) is retained, fed by manual-defined sampled time and measured dose, as instruction.md:3 requires.

Traced twa_for 85 + 3*log2(D/100), None at dose 0 (4.1); to_tenth floor(10v+0.5)/10 half-up (1.2); status_for over > 85.0, action >= 82.0, below otherwise/None (5.3) applied to the reported TWA; report.py forces 'over' on ceiling or impulse flag.
Traced flags: ceiling any run > 115.0 (equivalent to readings > 115.0 within the section-1 level domain, 5.1); impulse peak >= 140.0 (2.6, 5.2).

Traced groups: arithmetic mean of every member's unrounded shift dose including quiet members' 0.0 (6.1, 1.3), TWA by 4.1, rounded, status by bands alone with no flags; sorted() on capital-letter/digit codes gives digits before letters (README).

Hand-traced boundary witnesses: steady 80.0 dBA 480 min (dose 31.498%, counted); 79.9 dBA (not counted, but sampled); shift 600 with 450-min survey (partial, projected); 1440-min shift with two 1440-min runs (longer than shift, measured); peak exactly 140.0 (impulse); reading exactly 115.0 (not ceiling-flagged, counted at own level); all-quiet group (dose 0.0, twa null, below).

Considered float rounding of to_tenth near exact halves: an exact real half is impossible because TWA offsets are rational combinations of 2^(2k/60) versus an odd power 2^(j/60) with rational coefficients; only float noise (~1e-13) could flip a result, which is a precision limit common to any float implementation, not a contract violation.
